comment: Nice man and very funny, but mediocre professor. 1 HW per week but takes hours to complete b/c he does not go over the exact material. Many times I got stuck teaching myself from the book/online. Your grade is determined by 3 tests and a final exam. Only teaches by example and does not use the book for lectures. Jumps around a lot during lectures.

Professor Hoffer is my favorite professor so far. He is a fair grader and assigns a lot of homework from the book but he also gives extra credits, the exams are easy and, he will let you stay over time if you need to. He doesn't always explain the material very well but if you go to his office hours, he will grow found of you and you will be fine.

I thought professor Hoffer was wonderful. He has review sessions before tests and is always willing to help during office hours. The tests are straightforward and only cover material learned in class. The workload is not overwhelming and If you actually do the work you should get an A or B in the class.
The best professor I've ever had. Do the work and you get an A or B. Totally inspiring.

Dr. Hoffer is a really nice guy & has a hilarious sense of humor. His lectures tend to jump all over the place but he keeps it interesting. I think I might have learned more about the business world as a whole rather than straight economics, but it is a pretty easy class. Do your homework intentionally and go back over class notes on the reg.

Professor Hoffer was my favorite professor during my freshman year at UR. Class is always interesting and he explains all topics clearly with real life applications. He has optional study sessions before every exam and has office hours if you want to stop by to ask a question or just to chat. I highly recommend taking his class.

Dr. Hoffer is incredibly funny, and I'm enjoying his class greatly so far. He goes out of his way to make the subject understandable. Class is fairly easy, which makes me concerned about upper-level econ classes. Overall, though, I look forward to class, and  def. take his class if you can!

Best professor that I have had so far. Heknows what he is talking about and helps students outside of class. He gives extra credit for attending every class and also during class if you answer a question. He is a great teacher. I finished with lots of knowledge on the topic and a good grade
Professor Hoffer is an outstanding professor. This class was not boring for a single second thanks to his hilarious sense of humour.

The best professor at U of R for Economics, hands down, and one of the best in general.  The man's been in the business of Economics for 40 years and is regularly cited in the newspapers around here for his quotes on matters.  If you get him, consider yourself honored and record his lectures because you get firehosed w/ relevant information.  :)

My favorite class I have taken at Richmond thus far. I have never had a better lecture in my life. No matter what he is teaching it is worth taking. Class I took was easy, but its intro material and every section is easy.
